description_en: Retrieves the list of Thing Specification Language model versions for a specified product
description_zh: 调用该接口获取指定产品的物模型版本列表
name: ListThingModelVersion

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this parameter has a value, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product.
You can view the ProductKey on the Products page in the IoT Platform console or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html to obtain the ProductKey
parameters.help_zh:
产品的ProductKey。
可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看，或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看ProductKey的取值
parameters.name: product_key

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The data returned if the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的数据

ModelVersions.description_en: The list of Thing Specification Language model versions. The versions are sorted in reverse chronological order by publish time. The first version is the currently used version
ModelVersions.description_zh: 物模型版本列表。按照物模型发布时间倒序排列。第一个为当前使用的版本

Description.description_en: The description of the Thing Specification Language model version

GmtCreate.description_en: The timestamp when this version of the Thing Specification Language model was published. The value is a GMT timestamp in milliseconds
GmtCreate.description_zh: 该版本物模型发布时的时间戳，格式为GMT毫秒值

ModelVersion.description_en: The version number of the Thing Specification Language model

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
